name: Dumbbell Alternating Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at a preacher bench with both upper arms on the pad and a dumbbell in each hand, palms up.
Bend one elbow to lift its dumbbell toward your shoulder.
Lower it until the elbow is nearly straight and alternate arms.
tips: Keep the backs of your upper arms in contact with the pad.
Stop just short of locking your elbow at the bottom and keep your wrists straight.
